'''Zerot''' was the first [[Gender/Legends|male]] to establish a permanent settlement at an [[The Puddle (oasis)|oasis]], which eventually became known as [[The Puddle]]. The rocky outcropping jutting into the oasis was named after him, becoming [[Zerot's Point]].<ref name="HS" />
